question: Enumerate the failure modes created by COMPOSITION itself: two subsystems each owning part of one decision, a capability reachable by two paths with different permission checks, an ordering dependency between control planes, and duplicated state. Then specify a MECHANICAL detector for duplicate control planes that can run in CI over the design artifacts.

added_failure_mode.description: The detector keys duplicate detection on exact authority strings. If [REDACTED] generated catalogs and the [REDACTED] catalog surface are both labelled 'catalog', the row looks singular while two planes still govern the capability. Exact-string equality is not identity of planes.
added_failure_mode.required_followup: Give every plane a stable plane_id independent of display name, and treat alias maps as a second detector input, not a comment.
added_failure_mode.title: Distinct planes collapsed by identical authority strings

reviewer.enumeration_certify_reason: The 47 seeded classes are cited as _USER-PROMPTS.md:11300-11347. That file is not on this worktree. Certifying completeness against an unread list would be overclaim. Instead the reviewer adds FM-AUTHORITY-STRING-COLLISION, which the author's exact-string detector missed.
reviewer.method: Reviewed the author's four composition classes (split decision, dual-path permission, ordering, duplicated state) and the exact-string detector. Scope is: both-states, extraction-control, ordering list with failure-if-violated, one missed mode. Agreement with the hybrid being a good idea is not required.

scenario.catching_architecture: Mechanical duplicate-control-plane detector over capability_to_authority tables ([REDACTED] detector.py). Fail-closed on any capability with two authorities. A zero is trusted only after extraction-control finds capability-declaration.
procedure: Write a singular composed capability_to_authority table from catalog-derived [REDACTED]–[REDACTED] planes (source DESIGN.json files are absent on this worktree).
Run detector.py on the clean table; require extraction-control and zero duplicate findings.
Plant a second authority ([REDACTED]-product-surface) on authorization; require the detector to fire on that capability.
Run the detector on an empty table and refuse to treat that zero as CLEAN (extraction-control).
Run the detector on the naive [REDACTED]+[REDACTED] union and record duplicate findings on capability-declaration.
Enumerate every cross-plane ordering constraint with the failure it causes if reversed.
scenario.title: Planted duplicate authority fires; clean composed mapping is silent

strongest_surviving_counterargument: Operators will keep a second plane as a hot overlay ([REDACTED] catalog view beside [REDACTED] generated catalogs, [REDACTED] static tree beside generated bytes) because the two views 'always agree' in the common case. That preference survives as an operational habit. It does not make dual authority fail-closed, it does not make a vacuous zero a pass, and it does not conjure [REDACTED]/DESIGN.json on this worktree.
title: [REDACTED] ([REDACTED]): Failure modes created by composition itself, and a mechanical duplicate-control-plane detector
